text:
## Third-Party Risk  
### Vendor Security Assessment  
**Pre-Assessment:**
- Security questionnaire completed
- SOC 2 Type II audit reviewed (if available)
- Penetration test results (if applicable)
- Reference checks (other customers)  
**Ongoing:**
- Annual re-assessment
- Incident notification requirements (SLA: 24 hours)
- Audit rights (FirstUK Bank can audit vendor)
- Service Level Agreement (SLA) for security

raw_entities.name: Third-Party Risk Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy governing the management of risks associated with third-party vendors, specifically focusing on security assessments and ongoing monitoring requirements.

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Pre-Assessment Security Questionnaire
raw_entities.description: Requirement that a security questionnaire must be completed as part of the pre-assessment process for third-party vendors.

raw_entities.name: SOC 2 Type II Audit Review
raw_entities.description: Requirement to review a vendor's SOC 2 Type II audit report during the pre-assessment phase, where such a report is available.
context: SOC 2 Type II audit reviewed (if available)

raw_entities.name: Penetration Test Result Review
raw_entities.description: Requirement to review penetration test results during the pre-assessment phase, if applicable to the vendor.

raw_entities.name: Vendor Reference Checks
raw_entities.description: Requirement to conduct reference checks with other customers of the third-party vendor during pre-assessment.

raw_entities.name: Annual Vendor Re-assessment
raw_entities.description: Mandate for the bank to perform a security re-assessment of third-party vendors on an annual basis.

raw_entities.name: Vendor Incident Notification Timeframe
raw_entities.description: Obligation for vendors to notify FirstUK Bank of security incidents within a 24-hour Service Level Agreement (SLA) window.

raw_entities.name: Right to Audit Third-Party Vendors
raw_entities.description: Provision granting FirstUK Bank the explicit right to conduct audits of its third-party vendors.
context: Audit rights (FirstUK Bank can audit vendor)

raw_entities.name: Security Service Level Agreement Requirement
raw_entities.description: Requirement for a formal Service Level Agreement (SLA) specifically covering security standards for third-party vendors.

raw_entities.name: Third-Party Risk
raw_entities.description: Risks arising from the use of external vendors, specifically regarding their security posture and ability to protect bank data.

raw_entities.name: Vendor Security Questionnaire
raw_entities.description: An operational tool used to collect security data from vendors during the pre-assessment phase.

raw_entities.name: SOC 2 Type II Audit Review
raw_entities.description: The process of reviewing external audit reports to verify a vendor's internal controls.
context: SOC 2 Type II audit reviewed (if available)

raw_entities.name: Penetration Testing Review
raw_entities.description: The review of technical security testing results to identify vulnerabilities in a vendor's environment.

raw_entities.name: Third-Party Vendor
raw_entities.description: External entities providing services to FirstUK Bank, subject to security assessments, audit rights, and incident notification SLAs.

raw_entities.name: FirstUK Bank
raw_entities.description: The governing institution responsible for conducting vendor assessments and exercising audit rights.
